# A06 research and repair record — 2026-09-15

Baseline: `3b06832`. Coordinator owns shared history, audience integration and final verification.
This is an implementer record; independent review is still required.

## Research before implementation

History does not calculate Draw Steel rules. Its mechanical effects must follow the confirmed
application contracts: [undo and seams](../../table-spec.md#undo-permissions-and-proposed-campaign-control),
[inline corrections](../../table-spec.md#director-edits-to-inline-results), and
[separate character progression](../../data-architecture-spec.md#4-user-records-and-current-state).
The A06 slice explicitly requires review against those rulings rather than inventing corpus rules
for application history. Linked A04/A05 research covers any changed arithmetic independently.

- Q-A-601 is already answered: disabling user undo also disables player edge/bane corrections;
  Director authority remains subject to the ordinary sequential window. No new question.
- Q-A-600 is already answered: players cannot undo Take turn. Redo retains the same authority and
  seam bounds as undo; it must not provide a route across the turn-start floor.
- Character review/progression is independent of gameplay history. Admission/review entries must
  not be marked undone while their effective builds and review decisions remain unchanged.
- Pending targeting is preparation, and blocked activation spends nothing. These records must not
  become pretend gameplay undo units. Player undo clears the invoking user's pending targeting.
- A player's own correction is a character action; a Director correction is a seam. The actor and
  recorded issuing role must be preserved when classifying the correction.
- Current Malice, difficulty and monster-health audiences apply to every historical read, including
  history-control targets, refusal reasons and the embedded descriptions in undo/redo entries.
- Restoration must replay complete recorded before/after state without rules/dice calls, including
  recreated document references. Repeated deletion/restoration needs actual persisted assertions.

The legacy `/hero recover` combat path delegates to the same Catch Breath operation as the sheet.
The pinned [Catch Breath source](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/feature/common/maneuvers/catch-breath.md)
names its maneuver cost and one Recovery spend; [Recoveries](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/rule/health/recoveries.md)
sets one-third maximum Stamina rounded down and permits repeated spending outside combat. R04's confirmed
cap applies. A05 research covers the shared implementation; this integration removes a second combat path
that omitted the maneuver journal. No new rules interpretation is introduced.

Manual clause dispositions are current-card continuations. Several directly linked dispositions may be
recorded consecutively, and formal closeout offers outstanding current-encounter clauses. Ordinary historical
corrections retain the strict sequential window; archive/session/branch restrictions apply to both.

## Findings and verification

The root repair is independently reviewed in [the A06 verdict](2026-09-15-A06-review.md).
The new five-test persisted audit covers admission separation, targeting/undo clearing, historical
Malice audiences, Q-A-601 correction authority, repeated foe recreation and correction through aliases,
and legacy Catch Breath combat action tracking/retry. All pass; original history and audience suites
also pass. Historical result-list windows share one loaded history walk. Complete reads replace silent
history truncation so a long session cannot accidentally restore an older head.

The connected A09 walkthrough and final browser/visual verification are recorded separately in
[acceptance evidence](../evidence/v001-acceptance.md). This record does not certify deferred unique
source effects, V1 history interfaces or a multi-hour performance budget.
